class.name: DPITexture
class.brief_description: A texture that automatically scales based on DPI for resolution-independent rendering.
class.description: [DPITexture] is a [Texture2D] resource that automatically scales its source texture based on the current display DPI. This allows for resolution-independent rendering, ensuring that textures appear at consistent physical sizes across displays with different pixel densities. The texture can apply color mapping and saturation adjustments, making it particularly useful for editor themes and UI elements that need to adapt to different display configurations. [b]Note:[/b] DPITexture caches scaled versions of the texture at different DPI levels to optimize performance.

method.name: create_from_string
method.description: Creates a [DPITexture] from the specified source path with optional scale, saturation, and color mapping.

method.name: reference_scaling_level
method.description: Increments the reference count for a specific scaling level. Used internally for cache management.

method.name: unreference_scaling_level
method.description: Decrements the reference count for a specific scaling level. Used internally for cache management.

members.member: The base scale factor for the texture. The texture will be scaled relative to this base value when rendering at different DPI levels.
A dictionary mapping source colors to replacement colors. Useful for dynamically recoloring textures based on theme settings.
The saturation adjustment applied to the texture. Values less than 1.0 desaturate the texture, while values greater than 1.0 increase saturation.
The path to the source texture file. This can be a path to any supported image format.
